terms: Live terms (v2 props): NBA threes / rebounds / assists and NFL receptions / yards / touchdowns and quarterback passing touchdowns / interceptions / completions only, rebounds / threes / assists buy once ESPN and Sleeper agree (ESPN's two views whenever Sleeper has no fresh reading), points after the next stoppage + 3 s of clock, NFL 3 s after the next real snap (not a timeout, flag or the same play posting late), every NBA stat (assists included unless an assists bet has lost, which turns assists off) and NFL touchdowns up to $1,500 per market, NFL receiving / rushing yards $1,500 once 15+ past the line, $1,000 at 10+, $500 before, and $500 whenever the game has a minute or less left, everything else $500; rebounds and threes take 98c-or-better stock first and re-fire while it keeps coming back, everything else walks the book from the cheapest ask up to 0.99; after any buy it keeps re-buying at 99c while sellers reload (stops after 10s with no fill, 15 rounds, the market cap, or the moment the stat moves against us or a correction hold starts); no crowd-bid requirement (the 98c seller is the crowd signal); unders only after the final, box unchanged 75 s on both ESPN views and matched by the second source (Sleeper) whenever it is reporting the game; a cash shortage never stops the night, clinch waits and fires when money returns; no per-game cap, cash floor $500, night pauses after 2 settled losses (every loss texts), no resting bids. Also watching, never buying (recorded to watchonly_<date>.jsonl; no cash, caps or loss stop touched), watch-only: KXNFLBOTH, KXNFLDSTTD, KXNFLFG, KXNFLLONGREC, KXNFLLONGRSH, KXNFLPASSATT, KXNFLRRYDS, KXNFLRSHATT, KXNFLSFTY, KXNFLTEAMSACK, KXNHLAST, KXNHLGOAL, KXNHLPTS, KXNHLSAVE.
